newsitem.title: THAILAND: Cambodia urges Thailand to boost border trade.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia urges Thailand to boost border trade.

text.p: Cambodia's second Prime Minister Hun Sen on Saturday asked Thailand to consider opening more border checkpoints to boost trade between the two countries, Thai government spokesman Varathep Rattanakorn said.
But Hun Sen reiterated Cambodia's ban on logging exports, Varathep said.
Cambodia has accused Thai businessmen of violating the ban.
Hun Sen, who arrived on Friday from a three-day official visit to Burma, met Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh.
Varathep said Hun Sen suggested that seven more border checkpoints should be added to the existing three to ease cross-border trade.
"Cambodia still needed a lot of consumer goods and contruction materials. At the same time, the country wanted to sell agriculture products such as corn to Thailand," Varathep said.

Hun Sen also expressed interest in buying power from Thailand for border provinces, especially areas recently recaptured from the Khmer Rouge guerrillas. He also sought cooperation from Thailand in building a dam for power generation.

The details on the the planned purchase of power and opening of border checkpoints would be discussed by officials from both sides in Thailand's northern city of Chiang Mai from March 20-22, the spokesman said.
